overview:
A critical OpenJDK Base64 memory-corruption vulnerability requires immediate attention from operators of affected Java installations. Equinor reports an ongoing cyberattack on corporate IT with production unaffected, while Apple is recovering from a multi-service outage attributed to an internal update.

OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol; Microsoft introduced MAI Code 2 models. jQuery 4.1.0 and 3.8.0 fix selector ReDoS, and Solid 2.0 reaches stable. Practical experiments in CSS-only UI, formal database verification and GPU inference education add engineering depth.
